vocab.q: The building's innovative design has won _____ from architects around the world.
vocab.exp: acclaim は名詞で「称賛」。proclaim / exclaim は動詞。

vocab.q: The supplier was unable to _____ our order on time.
vocab.exp: fulfill は「（注文・義務を）果たす」。
vocab.point: fulfill an order「注文に応じる・納品する」

vocab.q: The study found a strong _____ between regular exercise and productivity.
vocab.exp: corporation は「企業」、coordination は「調整」。
vocab.point: correlation between A and B「A と B の相関関係」

vocab.q: Customers are encouraged to provide _____ on our new service.
vocab.exp: setback は「挫折」、fallback は「代替策」。

vocab.q: The company has _____ plans to build a factory in Vietnam.
vocab.exp: unveil は「（新製品・計画を）公表する」。unload は「荷を降ろす」。

vocab.q: Due to budget _____, the company cannot hire additional staff this year.
vocab.exp: constraint は「制約」。consent は「同意」、constant は「定数」。

vocab.q: The meeting was _____ until the following Monday.
vocab.exp: adjoin は「隣接する」、adjudge は「判決を下す」。
vocab.point: adjourn「休会にする・延期する」

vocab.q: Ms. Kato _____ her colleagues for their hard work.
vocab.exp: prize は「大切にする」、price は「値段をつける」。
vocab.point: praise 人 for ～「人を～でほめる」

vocab.q: The manager _____ that the report be revised before Friday.
vocab.exp: that 節が原形 be revised なので、要求を表す insist。persist は「固執する」（in が必要）。
vocab.point: insist that S (should) 原形「～するよう強く求める」

vocab.q: The project manager _____ tasks to each team member based on their strengths.
vocab.exp: delude は「欺く」、delete は「削除する」。
vocab.point: delegate A to B「A を B に任せる」

vocab.q: The new CEO has pledged to _____ the company's image after the scandal.
vocab.exp: restrain は「抑える」、restrict は「制限する」、retract は「撤回する」。

vocab.q: Investors remain _____ about the company's long-term prospects.
vocab.exp: remain の補語の形容詞。opportunistic は「ご都合主義の」。
vocab.point: optimistic about ～「～について楽観的な」

vocab.q: The two parties failed to reach a _____ after months of talks.
vocab.exp: census は「国勢調査」、concession は「譲歩」（make a concession）。
vocab.point: reach a consensus「合意に達する」

vocab.q: Please _____ the attached file to verify that it opens correctly.
vocab.exp: downsize は「縮小する」、downplay は「軽視する」、downgrade は「格下げする」。
vocab.point: download a file「ファイルをダウンロードする」

vocab.q: The factory has been operating at full _____ since the new orders arrived.
vocab.exp: capacity は「生産能力・収容力」。capability は「（潜在的な）能力」で at full ～ の形をとらない。

vocab.q: The marketing campaign was designed to _____ younger consumers.
vocab.exp: attend to は「対応する」、apply to は「当てはまる・申し込む」。

vocab.q: Visitors must _____ at the reception desk before entering the laboratory.
vocab.exp: enroll は「（講座に）入学・登録する」、subscribe は「定期購読する」。受付での記帳は register。
vocab.point: register at ～「～で受付をする・登録する」

vocab.q: We regret to inform you that the item you ordered is temporarily out of _____.
vocab.exp: 決まった言い方は out of stock。supply は in short supply の形で使う。

vocab.q: Ms. Rivera was _____ to the position of regional director last month.
vocab.exp: 役職への昇進は promote。raise は給料など、advance は自動詞で使うことが多い。

vocab.q: Our customer service team will respond to your inquiry _____.
vocab.exp: promptly は「即座に」。punctually は「時間通りに」で約束の時刻があるときに使う。

vocab.q: The contract will _____ automatically unless either party gives notice.
vocab.exp: 契約の更新は renew。resume は「再開する」、restore は「元に戻す」。

vocab.q: Applicants should have a _____ command of both English and French.
vocab.exp: command of a language と結びつくのは fluent（または good / strong）。
vocab.point: a fluent command of ～「～を流ちょうに使いこなす力」

vocab.q: The factory has _____ its production to meet the growing demand.
vocab.exp: 他動詞で目的語 its production を取るのは increase。grow / rise はこの意味では自動詞。

vocab.q: Due to _____ weather, the outdoor concert has been moved indoors.
vocab.exp: inclement は weather と結びつく定番の形容詞。

vocab.q: The software update will be _____ to all users next week.
vocab.exp: 製品・情報の公開は release。relieve は「和らげる」。
vocab.point: release an update「更新を公開する」

vocab.q: Ticket holders may _____ their seats up to thirty minutes before the show.
vocab.exp: claim は「（権利として）受け取る」。insist は on が必要。
vocab.point: claim one's seat「席を確保する・受け取る」

vocab.q: The CEO's speech _____ the importance of teamwork.
vocab.exp: emphasize は他動詞で直接目的語を取る。insist は on、stress は他動詞なので on は不要。

vocab.q: The new branch office is expected to _____ fifty new jobs.
vocab.exp: jobs と結びつくのは create。invent は「発明する」。

vocab.q: Shipping charges will be _____ for orders over $50.
vocab.exp: waive は料金・権利の放棄。waver は「揺れる」、withhold は「差し控える」。
vocab.point: waive a fee「料金を免除する」

vocab.q: Mr. Chen has _____ experience in international trade.
vocab.exp: 経験・知識の豊富さは extensive。expensive は「高価な」。

vocab.q: The quarterly report must be _____ to the head office by the 10th of each month.
vocab.exp: 提出は submit。
vocab.point: submit a report「報告書を提出する」

vocab.q: The bridge will be closed for repairs for an _____ period.
vocab.exp: indefinite は「期限の定まらない」。infinite は「無限の」で期間には使わない。
vocab.point: for an indefinite period「無期限に」

vocab.q: The two companies have formed a strategic _____ to develop new technologies.
vocab.exp: alliance「提携」。compliance は「法令順守」、appliance は「家電」。
vocab.point: form a strategic alliance「戦略的提携を結ぶ」

vocab.q: Our sales figures _____ a steady increase over the past three years.
vocab.exp: データが「示す」は show（または indicate）。
vocab.point: figures show ～「数値は～を示している」

vocab.q: Employees must wear identification badges _____ times while on the premises.
vocab.exp: 決まった言い方は at all times。

vocab.q: The new policy will _____ effect on July 1.
vocab.exp: 規則の発効は take effect。have an effect on は「～に影響を与える」。
vocab.point: take effect「（法律・規則が）発効する」

vocab.q: The staff were _____ for their hard work during the busy season.
vocab.exp: reward A for B「B に対して A に報いる」。award は賞そのものを与える（award A B）。
vocab.point: be rewarded for ～「～に対して報われる」

vocab.q: The seminar will _____ topics such as time management and leadership.
vocab.exp: 講義・本などが「扱う」は cover。

vocab.q: Please _____ that all lights are turned off before leaving the office.
vocab.exp: that 節を取り「確実にする」は ensure。assure は assure 人 that、insure は「保険をかける」。

vocab.q: The production schedule had to be _____ due to a shortage of parts.
vocab.exp: 予定の修正は revise。reverse は「逆転させる」、revive は「復活させる」。
vocab.point: revise a schedule「予定を見直して変更する」

vocab.q: Many residents _____ to the proposal to build a new highway.
vocab.exp: to を取るのは object。oppose / resist は他動詞で to 不要、disagree with の後に to は来ない。

vocab.q: The museum's new exhibit has attracted a _____ number of visitors.
vocab.exp: record は形容詞的に「記録的な」。
vocab.point: a record number of ～「記録的な数の～」

vocab.q: Our company prides _____ on the quality of its products.
vocab.exp: 主語 Our company を受ける再帰代名詞 itself。
vocab.point: pride oneself on ～「～を誇りにする」

vocab.q: This coupon is valid _____ purchases made before December 31.
vocab.exp: 「～に対して有効」は valid for。

vocab.q: The deadline for applications has been _____ until March 15.
vocab.exp: 期限の延長は extend。expand / enlarge は大きさ・範囲。
vocab.point: extend a deadline「締め切りを延長する」

vocab.q: Staff members are _____ encouraged to attend the safety workshop.
vocab.exp: 過去分詞 encouraged を修飾する副詞 strongly。

vocab.q: The company plans to _____ its operations into Southeast Asia.
vocab.exp: 事業の拡大・進出は expand (into)。

vocab.q: Ms. Patel was _____ as the most valuable employee of the year.
vocab.exp: 功績を認めるのは recognize。realize は「気づく・実現する」。
vocab.point: be recognized as ～「～として表彰・認められる」

vocab.q: The store will be closed _____ the national holiday.
vocab.exp: 祝日のための休業は in observance of。in favor of は「～に賛成して」。
vocab.point: in observance of ～「～を祝して・のため」

vocab.q: The new equipment has significantly _____ the efficiency of the assembly line.
vocab.exp: 改善は improve。

vocab.q: The company has a strict _____ regarding the use of personal devices at work.
vocab.exp: 方針・規定は policy。politics は「政治」。

vocab.q: The two departments will _____ on the development of the new software.
vocab.exp: on を取って「協力する」は collaborate。corroborate は「裏付ける」。

vocab.q: The marketing campaign was a _____ success.
vocab.exp: resounding success は定番の結びつき。

vocab.q: The company's annual revenue _____ $10 million for the first time.
vocab.exp: 数値を「超える」は exceed。excel は「秀でる」。

vocab.q: Our office supplies are running _____, so please order more.
vocab.exp: run low / run short は補語に形容詞。short of は後ろに名詞が必要。
vocab.point: run low「（在庫が）少なくなる」

vocab.q: Candidates will be _____ on their communication and problem-solving skills.
vocab.exp: 人の能力評価は evaluate。evacuate は「避難させる」。
vocab.point: be evaluated on ～「～について評価される」

vocab.q: _____ to the trade fair is free for registered members.
vocab.exp: admission to an event は「入場」。entry fee は「入場料」なので free と意味が重複し、to the trade fair とも結びつかない。

vocab.q: The board will _____ a final decision at next week's meeting.
vocab.exp: reach は他動詞。arrive / come は at が必要。

vocab.q: The keynote speaker _____ the audience with her inspiring story.
vocab.exp: captivate は「魅了する」。capitulate は「降伏する」。
vocab.point: captivate an audience「聴衆を魅了する」

vocab.q: The research team has made significant _____ in cancer treatment.
vocab.exp: 進歩は advances。advantage は「利点」。
vocab.point: make advances in ～「～で進歩を遂げる」

vocab.q: Please _____ your seat belts while the sign is illuminated.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。
vocab.point: fasten a seat belt「シートベルトを締める」

vocab.q: The sales team exceeded _____ quota for the third quarter.
vocab.exp: the sales team を受ける所有格 its。it's は it is。
vocab.point: exceed one's quota「ノルマを超える」

vocab.q: The manual provides step-by-step _____ for assembling the furniture.
vocab.exp: 組み立ての「説明」は instructions。

vocab.q: Due to rising costs, the company had no _____ but to raise prices.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。
vocab.point: have no choice but to do「～するしかない」

vocab.q: The new parking regulations will be strictly _____.
vocab.exp: 規則の施行・取り締まりは enforce。reinforce は「補強する」。
vocab.point: enforce a regulation「規則を施行する」

vocab.q: The company _____ a 15 percent increase in profits this year.
vocab.exp: 業績の発表は report。
vocab.point: report an increase「増加を報告・発表する」

vocab.q: We appreciate your _____ in this matter.
vocab.exp: 所有格 your の後に名詞 cooperation。
vocab.point: appreciate your cooperation「ご協力に感謝する」

vocab.q: The CFO warned that the company's cash reserves were being _____ at an alarming rate.
vocab.exp: 資源・蓄えを減らすのは deplete。depict は「描く」、deport は「国外追放する」。

vocab.q: The consultant's recommendations were _____ to the company's actual needs.
vocab.exp: tailor は「（ニーズに）合わせる」。受動態で to と結びつく。
vocab.point: be tailored to ～「～に合わせて作られる」

vocab.q: Ms. Ndiaye has _____ a reputation as one of the most reliable suppliers in the region.
vocab.exp: 評判を「得る」は earn（establish, build も可）。deserve は「値する」。

vocab.q: The company will _____ a hiring freeze until the end of the fiscal year.
vocab.exp: 制限・規制を課すのは impose。

vocab.q: Because of the strike, deliveries may be _____ by up to a week.
vocab.exp: 配送の遅延は delay。detain は人を「引き留める」。

vocab.q: The firm's quarterly earnings fell _____ of analysts' expectations.
vocab.exp: fall short of は定番の表現。

vocab.q: The new software _____ users to track their expenses in real time.
vocab.exp: 目的語＋to do を取るのは enable / allow。let は原形不定詞、make も原形不定詞。
vocab.point: enable A to do「A が～できるようにする」

vocab.q: The landlord agreed to _____ the rent by ten percent if we signed a three-year lease.
vocab.exp: lower は動詞で「下げる」。to の後に原形。
vocab.point: lower the rent「家賃を下げる」

vocab.q: We are pleased to _____ that Dr. Haruka Ito will join our research team.
vocab.exp: 発表は announce。renounce は「放棄する」。
vocab.point: be pleased to announce that ～「～をお知らせします」

vocab.q: The bank requires two forms of identification to _____ an account.
vocab.exp: 口座の開設は open。
vocab.point: open an account「口座を開設する」

vocab.q: The delivery truck was _____ in heavy traffic for over an hour.
vocab.exp: stuck「動けない」。stack は「積み重ねる」。
vocab.point: be stuck in traffic「渋滞にはまる」

vocab.q: Ms. Alvarez _____ the importance of meeting deadlines in her opening remarks.
vocab.exp: underscore = emphasize。undergo は「経験する」、underwrite は「保証・引き受ける」。

vocab.q: The museum _____ a small fee for special exhibitions.
vocab.exp: 料金を取るのは charge。cost は「（物が）費用がかかる」。
vocab.point: charge a fee「料金を請求する」

vocab.q: The supplier has _____ that the order will arrive by Tuesday.
vocab.exp: that 節を直接取るのは guarantee。assure は assure 人 that の形が基本。

vocab.q: Several employees _____ interest in the leadership training program.
vocab.exp: 関心の表明は express。

vocab.q: Unauthorized _____ of company software is strictly prohibited.
vocab.exp: 名詞「複製」は duplication。duplicity は「二枚舌」。

vocab.q: The company's founder remains actively _____ in day-to-day decisions.
vocab.exp: 関与は involved。

vocab.q: Please allow three to five business days for your order to be _____.
vocab.exp: 注文の処理は process（受動態）。proceed は自動詞で受動態にならない。
vocab.point: process an order「注文を処理する」

vocab.q: The city plans to _____ the old factory into an art center.
vocab.exp: into と結びつくのは convert。convey は「運ぶ・伝える」。
vocab.point: convert A into B「A を B に改装・転換する」

vocab.q: Mr. Okoye's proposal received _____ support from the committee.
vocab.exp: 全会一致は unanimous。anonymous は「匿名の」。

vocab.q: The manufacturer has _____ production of its older models.
vocab.exp: cease は「やめる」。seize は「つかむ・押収する」、cede は「譲る」。

vocab.q: The new regulations are intended to _____ consumers from unfair pricing.
vocab.exp: protect A from B が自然。prevent A from ～ing は「A が～するのを防ぐ」で、後に動名詞が来る。
vocab.point: protect A from B「A を B から守る」

vocab.q: The contract _____ that all work must be completed by June 30.
vocab.exp: 契約が「規定する」は stipulate。stifle は「抑え込む」。

vocab.q: Applicants who meet the requirements will be _____ for an interview.
vocab.exp: 連絡は contact。contract は「契約する」。
vocab.point: be contacted for ～「～のために連絡を受ける」

vocab.q: The company spokesperson declined to _____ on the rumors.
vocab.exp: on と結びつき自動詞で使えるのは comment。mention / state は他動詞で on 不要、remark on もあるが decline to comment が定型。
vocab.point: comment on ～「～について論評する」

vocab.q: The training program is designed to help employees _____ their full potential.
vocab.exp: 他動詞で目的語を取るのは reach。attain は他動詞なので to 不要。
vocab.point: reach one's full potential「潜在能力を最大限に発揮する」

vocab.q: The publisher has _____ the release of the book until next spring.
vocab.exp: 延期は postpone。

vocab.q: Any questions _____ the new policy should be directed to the human resources department.
vocab.exp: 前置詞として使える regarding。regards to は誤り（with regard to が正しい）。

vocab.q: The new branch will initially _____ a staff of twenty.
vocab.exp: 雇用は employ。deploy は「配備する」。
vocab.point: employ a staff of ～「～人のスタッフを雇用する」

vocab.q: The company's success can be _____ to its focus on innovation.
vocab.exp: trace A to B「A の原因を B にたどる」。
vocab.point: be traced to ～「～に起因する・さかのぼる」

vocab.q: The keynote address will be followed by a _____ discussion.
vocab.exp: 複合名詞 panel discussion。
vocab.point: a panel discussion「パネルディスカッション」

vocab.q: The financial report must be _____ by an independent auditor.
vocab.exp: 監査人による確認は review。revoke は「取り消す」。
vocab.point: be reviewed by ～「～に精査される」

vocab.q: The bus service will be _____ during the holiday period.
vocab.exp: 運行の縮小は reduce。deduce は「推論する」。

vocab.q: The company has introduced flexible working hours to _____ employee morale.
vocab.exp: boost は「高める」。boast は「自慢する」。

vocab.q: _____ your order, please call our customer service center.
vocab.exp: 目的を表す不定詞 To track。Tracking で始めると分詞構文になり意味上の主語が合わない。

vocab.q: The negotiations were _____ after both sides agreed to compromise.
vocab.exp: 交渉を終えるのは conclude。seclude は「隔離する」。

vocab.q: The new president has vowed to _____ the company's debt within three years.
vocab.exp: to の後に原形で「なくす」は eliminate。illuminate は「照らす」、elaborate は「詳しく述べる」。

vocab.q: Mr. Takahashi was _____ by the board to lead the restructuring effort.
vocab.exp: 受動態で過去分詞 chosen。
vocab.point: be chosen to do「～するよう選ばれる」

vocab.q: Our technicians are available _____ the clock to assist you.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。

vocab.q: Prices for raw materials have _____ sharply in recent months.
vocab.exp: 価格の急騰は soar。sour は「悪化する」で over は不要、sow は「種をまく」。

vocab.q: Hotel guests may _____ their valuables in the safe at the front desk.
vocab.exp: 預けるのは deposit。dispose は of を伴い「処分する」。

vocab.q: The software developer released a _____ to fix the security flaw.
vocab.exp: ソフトの修正は patch。
vocab.point: release a patch「修正プログラムを公開する」

vocab.q: Our office will be _____ to a new location next month.
vocab.exp: 移転は relocate。relegate は「格下げする」。

vocab.q: The government has introduced new measures to _____ economic growth.
vocab.exp: 経済の刺激は stimulate。simulate は「模擬する」。

vocab.q: The company has _____ an agreement with a local university to share research.
vocab.exp: forge は「（関係・協定を）築く」。

vocab.q: Please notify the front desk if you require a wake-up _____.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。
vocab.point: a wake-up call「モーニングコール」

vocab.q: The company is _____ its customer service operations to improve response times.
vocab.exp: 組織の再編は restructure。restrict は「制限する」。

vocab.q: The hotel is _____ booked during the festival, so reserve early.
vocab.exp: 過去分詞 booked を修飾する副詞 typically。

vocab.q: The new manager quickly _____ a good relationship with her staff.
vocab.exp: 関係を築くのは establish。esteem は「尊敬する」。

vocab.q: Customers can _____ their orders online at any time.
vocab.exp: 配送状況の追跡は track。
vocab.point: track an order「注文を追跡する」

vocab.q: The proposal will be _____ to a vote at the next meeting.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。
vocab.point: put A to a vote「A を採決にかける」

vocab.q: Unfortunately, the item you requested has been _____.
vocab.exp: 製品の販売終了は discontinue。discount は「値引きする」。

vocab.q: The museum's guided tours are conducted in several _____.
vocab.exp: several の後に複数名詞 languages。

vocab.q: Employees who wish to work remotely must _____ a request to their supervisor.
vocab.exp: 提出は submit。
vocab.point: submit a request「申請を提出する」

vocab.q: The airline has added more flights to _____ the increase in demand.
vocab.exp: 需要に応えるのは meet。

vocab.q: The new shopping center is expected to _____ thousands of visitors every week.
vocab.exp: draw は「引き寄せる」。drain は「（資源を）消耗させる」。

vocab.q: The company's stock price has _____ since the announcement.
vocab.exp: 自動詞で「急落する」は plummet。plunge into は「～に飛び込む」で目的語が必要。

vocab.q: The team worked _____ to meet the tight deadline.
vocab.exp: 動詞を修飾する副詞 tirelessly。

vocab.q: The company has _____ a new marketing strategy aimed at young adults.
vocab.exp: 考案は devise。devote は to を伴う。
vocab.point: devise a strategy「戦略を考案する」

vocab.q: The company _____ its employees with free lunches on Fridays.
vocab.exp: A with B の形を取るのは provide。offer / give は二重目的語、supply A with B は可能だが to が付くと誤り。
vocab.point: provide A with B「A に B を提供する」

vocab.q: The director gave a brief _____ of the company's history.
vocab.exp: 概要は overview。overlook は「見落とす」。

vocab.q: The new CEO intends to _____ the company's struggling retail division.
vocab.exp: 組織を立て直すのは overhaul。overtake は「追い越す」、overstate は「誇張する」。

vocab.q: Several board members voiced _____ about the cost of the expansion.
vocab.exp: reservations は「懸念・留保」。resolutions は「決議」。
vocab.point: have reservations about ～「～に懸念を抱く」

vocab.q: The company _____ a loss of $3 million in the second quarter.
vocab.exp: 他動詞で損失・費用を負うのは incur。occur は自動詞。

vocab.q: The proposal was rejected on the _____ that it was too expensive.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。basis は on the basis of の形。
vocab.point: on the grounds that ～「～という理由で」

vocab.q: The new tax law will _____ small businesses the most.
vocab.exp: 動詞「影響する」は affect。effect は主に名詞。

vocab.q: Researchers are trying to _____ the cause of the equipment failure.
vocab.exp: 原因の特定は pinpoint。

vocab.q: The retailer has _____ its online presence by launching a mobile app.
vocab.exp: 強化は strengthen。strain は「負担をかける」。
vocab.point: strengthen one's presence「存在感を強める」

vocab.q: Ms. Moreau's _____ of the report helped the team spot several errors.
vocab.exp: 文書の誤り探しは proofreading。

vocab.q: Factory workers must _____ strict hygiene standards.
vocab.exp: 規則を守るのは adhere to。admit to は「認める」。

vocab.q: The two companies have been _____ rivals for decades.
vocab.exp: fierce は「激しい」。feeble は「弱い」。

vocab.q: The financial crisis _____ many companies to cut jobs.
vocab.exp: 目的語＋to do を取るのは force。enforce は規則を「施行する」。
vocab.point: force A to do「A に～させる」

vocab.q: The CEO _____ that the company would return to profitability next year.
vocab.exp: 予測は predict。preside は over を伴い「司会する」。

vocab.q: Please _____ from smoking anywhere on the hospital grounds.
vocab.exp: from を伴うのは abstain。abolish は「廃止する」。

vocab.q: The construction company won a _____ to build a new highway.
vocab.exp: 入札は bid。
vocab.point: win a bid「入札を勝ち取る」

vocab.q: The board has _____ Ms. Ochoa as the next chief financial officer.
vocab.exp: 役職への指名は name（appoint）。title は「題をつける」。
vocab.point: name A as B「A を B に指名する」

vocab.q: The software automatically _____ your work every five minutes.
vocab.exp: 保存は save。salvage は「回収する」。
vocab.point: save one's work「作業を保存する」

vocab.q: The company is _____ to delays because it relies on a single supplier.
vocab.exp: 影響を受けやすいのは vulnerable。venerable は「尊敬すべき」。

vocab.q: The agreement will remain in _____ for five years.
vocab.exp: 法律・契約の効力は in force。
vocab.point: remain in force「有効であり続ける」

vocab.q: The firm is known for its _____ approach to customer service.
vocab.exp: proactive は「先手を打つ」。provocative は「挑発的な」。
vocab.point: a proactive approach「先を見越した取り組み」

vocab.q: Due to the storm, the ferry service has been _____ for the day.
vocab.exp: 運行停止は suspend。sustain は「持続させる」。
vocab.point: suspend service「運行を一時停止する」

vocab.q: The company is seeking to _____ its dependence on imported materials.
vocab.exp: lessen は「減らす」。loosen は「緩める」。

vocab.q: Visitors are _____ to wear comfortable shoes for the walking tour.
vocab.exp: 人＋to do の受動態が取れるのは advise。advocate は人を目的語にしない。
vocab.point: be advised to do「～するよう勧められる」

vocab.q: The marketing campaign _____ a 20 percent increase in online sales.
vocab.exp: 生み出すのは generate。
vocab.point: generate an increase「増加を生み出す」

vocab.q: The team leader _____ a meeting to discuss the client's complaints.
vocab.exp: 会議の招集は call。
vocab.point: call a meeting「会議を招集する」

vocab.q: The library has _____ its collection of digital books.
vocab.exp: 範囲を広げるのは broaden。broadcast は「放送する」。
vocab.point: broaden a collection「収蔵を広げる」

vocab.q: Ms. Sanchez will _____ a workshop on effective presentation skills.
vocab.exp: 指導・進行は lead。lend は「貸す」。
vocab.point: lead a workshop「ワークショップを指導する」

vocab.q: The company has _____ a new code of conduct for all employees.
vocab.exp: 文書の起草は draft。drift は「漂う」。
vocab.point: draft a code「規定の草案を作る」

vocab.q: The defective products will be replaced _____ charge.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。

vocab.q: The new office is _____ larger than the old one.
vocab.exp: 比較級を強めるのは considerably。considerately は「思いやりをもって」。

vocab.q: A _____ of the meeting will be sent to all participants.
vocab.exp: 議事の要約は summary。summon は「呼び出す」。

vocab.q: The supplier promised to _____ the damaged goods free of charge.
vocab.exp: 交換は replace。displace は「移動させる」、misplace は「置き忘れる」。

vocab.q: The manager asked staff to _____ their vacation requests by the end of the month.
vocab.exp: to の後で動詞が必要かつ意味が合う finalize。

vocab.q: The hotel's new spa has proven _____ popular with guests.
vocab.exp: 形容詞 popular を修飾する副詞。
vocab.point: enormously popular「非常に人気がある」

vocab.q: The company plans to _____ its headquarters to a more central location.
vocab.exp: 移転は transfer。transform は「変形する」、transmit は「送信する」。
vocab.point: transfer A to B「A を B へ移す」

vocab.q: The new safety procedures have been _____ by all departments.
vocab.exp: 採用は adopt。adapt は「適応させる」。

vocab.q: Customers can _____ a complaint through our online form.
vocab.exp: 申し立ては file。fill は fill out で書類。
vocab.point: file a complaint「苦情を申し立てる」

vocab.q: The quality control team _____ every product before it is shipped.
vocab.exp: 品質の検査は inspect。

vocab.q: The museum is planning to _____ a new wing next year.
vocab.exp: to の後で動詞が必要。inaugural は形容詞。
vocab.point: inaugurate「開設する、正式に開始する」

vocab.q: The financial advisor _____ clients on long-term investment strategies.
vocab.exp: 助言は counsel。council は名詞「評議会」、conceal は「隠す」。
vocab.point: counsel A on B「A に B について助言する」

vocab.q: The company has a _____ of hiring locally whenever possible.
vocab.exp: a の後に名詞で「慣行」は practice。
vocab.point: have a practice of ～ing「～するのを慣行としている」

vocab.q: The hotel staff did everything they could to make our stay _____.
vocab.exp: make O C の C は形容詞 enjoyable。
vocab.point: make A enjoyable「A を楽しいものにする」

vocab.q: The CEO's decision to step down _____ the entire industry.
vocab.exp: 驚かせるのは stun。stunt は「成長を妨げる」。

vocab.q: The software is _____ with both Windows and Mac computers.
vocab.exp: 互換性は compatible。comparable は to を伴い「匹敵する」。

vocab.q: The company's growth has been _____ by a shortage of skilled workers.
vocab.exp: 成長を抑えるのは constrain。contain は「含む・封じ込める」。
vocab.point: be constrained by ～「～に制約される」

vocab.q: The new mall is expected to _____ the local economy.
vocab.exp: 経済の活性化は revitalize。revere は「崇敬する」。

vocab.q: Ms. Tanaka _____ the opportunity to work at the overseas office.
vocab.exp: 機会に飛びつくのは jump at。
vocab.point: jump at the chance「機会に飛びつく」

vocab.q: The proposal is still in the _____ stages of development.
vocab.exp: 定番の表現。
vocab.point: in the early stages「初期段階で」

vocab.q: _____ hours for the store are 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.
vocab.exp: 複合名詞 business hours。

vocab.q: The company has been _____ by its competitors in recent years.
vocab.exp: 競争で抜かれるのは outpace。outspoken は「率直な」。

vocab.q: The airline was _____ for its poor handling of the delays.
vocab.exp: 受動態で過去分詞 criticized。
vocab.point: be criticized for ～「～で批判される」

vocab.q: The training manual is _____ revised to reflect changes in procedure.
vocab.exp: 過去分詞を修飾する副詞。

reading.title: Email: Office relocation
reading.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Laura Kim, Facilities Manager
Subject: Office relocation

As many of you know, our Denver office will move to the Harmon Building on Fifth Street. The move will take place over the weekend of March 14. Please pack your personal belongings in the boxes provided by Thursday, March 12. Movers will handle all furniture and computer equipment. The new office will open on Monday, March 16, with parking available in the underground garage. Parking permits can be picked up from the reception desk on the first floor starting March 16.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To provide details about an office move
To announce a new parking policy
To introduce a new facilities manager
To request help with moving furniture
questions.exp: 冒頭で Denver office will move と移転の詳細を伝えている。
questions.point: 目的を問う問題 → 冒頭の1〜2文に答えがある

questions.q: By when should staff pack their belongings?
questions.exp: by Thursday, March 12 と明記。14日は引っ越し当日、16日は開業日。
questions.point: 日付の問題 → 「by ＋日付」の文を探す

questions.q: What is indicated about parking permits?
choices: They will be distributed at the reception desk.
They must be requested by email.
They will be mailed to employees.
questions.exp: can be picked up from the reception desk ＝ 受付で配布される。言い換えに注目。
questions.point: 言い換えに注意：picked up from ＝ distributed at

reading.title: Notice: Software update
reading.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL USERS

On Saturday, June 8, from 10:00 P.M. to 2:00 A.M., the company's internal network will be unavailable while the IT department installs a security update. During this time, employees will not be able to access email or shared drives. Staff working remotely are advised to save any files locally before 10:00 P.M. If you experience any problems logging in after the update, please contact the help desk at extension 4512. We apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.q: Why will the network be unavailable?
choices: A security update will be installed.
questions.exp: installs a security update が理由。
questions.point: 理由の問題 → while 以下が理由

questions.q: What are remote workers advised to do?
choices: Save files on their own devices
Call the help desk in advance
questions.exp: save any files locally ＝ 自分の端末に保存する。
questions.point: remote（在宅）の人への指示 → advised to の文
